Our Story

A treasure trove in the heart of Oak Bay Village

Nestled on Oak Bay Avenue in one of Victoria’s most charming neighbourhoods, Fantastic Finds is a destination for collectors, treasure hunters, and anyone with an eye for the extraordinary.

We specialize in vintage jewellery, sterling silver, fine crystal, antique furniture, curiosities, and one-of-a-kind pieces that carry the stories of another era. Every item in our shop has been hand-selected for its quality, character, and beauty.

Whether you’re searching for a statement necklace, a silver tea service, a brass telescope, or something you never knew you needed — you’ll find it here. Drop in, explore, and let the treasures find you.
